data.title: 泽塔 · 屋顶上的日光浴
data.description: 难得的休整日，泽塔穿着连帽卫衣蜷在据点屋顶晒太阳。嘴上说是监视据点周边，尾巴却舒服地卷成一团——猫的习性，藏不住。
data.location: sunny rooftop of a hideout with laundry lines and a view of the town
data.action: curled up napping on a sunny rooftop in an oversized hoodie, cat ears relaxed, tail curled around herself
data.mood: rare feline laziness, warm afternoon peace
data.promptProse: Officially, Zeta is surveilling the perimeter. Unofficially, the sun is warm and her tail has curled up on its own.
data.animaCaption: Surveillance, she insists. The curled tail says otherwise.
